name: Portfolio
definition: Wrapper for a specific product or a specific sub-product owned by a set of beneficial owners.

Transfer.name: Transfer
Transfer.definition: Transfer information related to a portfolio.

AssetDescription.name: Asset Description
AssetDescription.definition: Specifies the assets included in the portfolio together with their value.

Benchmark.name: Benchmark
Benchmark.definition: Information on the benchmark set for the portfolio.

InvestmentPlan.name: Investment Plan
InvestmentPlan.definition: Investment plan associated with a portfolio.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Account on which the portfolio is held.
